title: Linear response for random systems with a cusp
summary: We study i.i.d.\ random compositions of cusp tent-like interval maps having a common cusp point and a common cusp value. For cusp exponents $-1<β<-\frac12$, we prove that the associated annealed transfer operators have a spectral gap on $W^{1,1}(I)$ and $W^{2,1}(I)$. For all sufficiently small perturbations of the probability law, there is a stationary density $h_\varepsilon\in W^{2,1}(I)$, unique among stationary densities belonging to $W^{1,1}(I)$.
